core.title: Descartes Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob, Acorn PMH-T-07

text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-T-07, Descartes Cabinet Knob

The Descartes Knob made by Acorn Manufacturing has a retro modern look that will be a solid addition to any home remodel. This stainless steel knob has a brushed stainless steel finish, which is one of the best materials for a high traffic kitchen cabinet knob since it is resistant to scratches, abrasions, and the general grime that happens in a well-loved cooking space. The Descartes Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob comes packaged with the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching Descartes Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Descartes Kitchen Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Width: .97"
  • Projection: 1.40"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
